messages:
rowan (product): quick sync: org billing UX — two options: 'compact-ledger' (tight rows, per-row download in overflow) vs 'toolbar-primary' (big toolbar download for visible rows). which should be default for org? figma: https://figma.com/file/newmock
mei (design): prefer toolbar-primary for org (clean for execs). compact-ledger better for project pages.
ash (frontend): typo: that's ash. perf note: per-row download increases DOM work unless overflow-only. recommend overflow button that lazy-fetches menu.
ash (frontend): sample: use virtualization + lazy menu fetch to keep compact mode cheap.
samir (a11y): accessibility: overflow needs aria-expanded and keyboard navigation. toolbar download must announce scope ("Download visible invoices"). add toast when batch download starts.
lucy (data): quick numbers from prototype: users clicked row downloads 29% when visible; only 10% when toolbar-only. suggests discoverability matters.
ops-bot: background_job queued: invoice_zip_prepare id=job_993
rowan (product): leaning hybrid: org default = toolbar-primary + per-row overflow (no inline icons). project default = compact-ledger. A/B test 2 weeks. lucy measure metrics, ash+mike implement. mei update figma. samir will run a11y pass. sync Fri 11am. :white_check_mark:
